gist: Sensei tells Koyuki where to get a Wi-Fi account reset and waits while she does it at the IT desk.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:huddle:v5h2qk9cyd
# {DAY}
[you 09:10] *yawns* Why is the first period always maths?
[momoi-saiba 09:10] [face=pouting] Because the universe hates us.
[you] The universe has bad scheduling.
[momoi-saiba 09:12] Speaking of schedules, did you get the notice about the makeup quiz?
[you] [face=neutral] What makeup quiz?
[momoi-saiba] The one for the network class. You missed last week's, so it's Friday at 15:30 in Room 204.
[you 09:13] Oh. Thanks for telling me.
### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 11:30] Sensei, quick question! Who do I ask to get a new school Wi-Fi account? Mine says it expired.
[user:sensei 11:36] Hi Koyuki. The Millennium IT desk handles those. First floor of the admin building.
[you 11:37] What do I bring?
[user:sensei 11:38] Student ID and the account name. They'll reset the password in a few minutes.
[you] Is there a form?
[user:sensei 11:40] One page. They have it at the counter.
[you 11:41] Okay! When are they open?
[user:sensei 11:42] Weekdays 09:00 to 17:00. Closed for lunch from 12:00 to 13:00.
[you] [face=neutral] Then I'll go after school today.
[user:sensei] Good.
### chat:huddle:p8s3ew6lzr
# {DAY}
[you 16:10] *leans on the IT desk counter* Hello! I need a Wi-Fi reset!
[user:sensei 16:10] I'm only here to drop off a file, but I'll wait. Go ahead.
[you 16:11] *hands over the student ID*
[you] Koyuki Kurosaki, first year!
[user:sensei 16:12] The attendant says the form is the white one.
[you] *fills it in* Done!
[user:sensei] Make sure the room number is right.
[you 16:14] Dormitory C, room 312. Checked!
[user:sensei 16:15] Good. The new password is sent to your school mail within the hour.
[you] Thank you, Sensei! I'm off to the arcade.
[user:sensei] Don't forget the quiz on Friday, 15:30, Room 204.
[you 16:16] I remember! Probably!
[you 18:05] Sensei, the password mail came! It works!
[user:sensei 18:09] Good. Change it to something you'll remember.
[you 18:10] I'll write it on my hand!
